titre: Einstein, relativité générale et réalisme local
resume: Einstein's general relativity describes space and time as a woven 4D fabric in which reality is logical and predictable. His belief in local realism has two parts: things exist whether or not they are observed, and an event cannot instantly affect something far away without a link, delay or signal.
texte: Albert Einstein's greatest gift to the world was the theory of general relativity, also known as Einstein's theory of gravity. He discovered that space and time are woven together like a giant invisible 4D fabric. According to Einstein, reality is predictable, logical, and it makes total sense. He believed in the concept of local realism and it boiled down to two simple concepts. Things are real [music] whether you're looking at them or not. A rock on Mars doesn't stop existing because no one is there to see it. And events occurring in one location can't instantly affect something happening millions of miles away. There has to be a link, a delay, or a signal. It's a common sense view of the physical world, something even the average person can generally understand.
